newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Q1 1997 new homes completion flat yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Q1 1997 new homes completion flat yr/yr.

text.p: Hungary has completed 3,743 new homes in the first quarter of 1997 first half, up 0.7 percent on the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (CSO) said on Monday.
The number of approved building plans fell to 4,740 from 4,924 in the same period of 1996, the CSO said.

Note - Due to seasonal variations, new home completions in the first quarter are usually disproportionately low compared with full-year figures. In 1996, 13 percent of the year's new homes were completed in the first quarter.
New homes include both flats and houses.
